basis: Independent representative HAPS thermal study. No selected sensor/heater or manufacturer cold-start allowables. Delays are chosen physical-model scenarios, not measured specifications.
baseline: Stage04 selected PI: Kp300 W/K, Ki2 W/(K.s), back-calculation60s, 300 W installed motor heater, -5 C housing heating floor. Thermal network, heat capacities, external optics/IR and loss maps frozen.

initialization.other_nodes: Prior Stage04 initial values, except separately labeled entire-network -40 C sensitivity.
initialization.sensor: Initially same temperature as motor, not an artificial warm reading.
initialization.actuator: Filtered delivered-power state starts at0 W. Delayed cases start with actual power0 W and zero pre-start command history. The ideal cold case bypasses the output lag and applies300 W immediately at t=0.
initialization.loads: Prior prescribed mission motor, avionics and RF loads enabled at t=0; no startup operational interlock. A thermal warmup test, not a flight readiness or component survival assessment.

dynamics.interpretation: First-order sensor temperature; pure command transport delay; first-order delivered electrical power after the delay. Averaged power, no PWM/noise/bias/faults. Heater power lag is an actuator/output approximation, not an additional heater thermal mass, so no hidden stored heat is added. Delivered power enters both thermal and DC-bus balances.

headroom_candidate.interpretation: Power reserve is deliberately imposed, at the cost of slower warmup. Reaching this software ceiling is recorded separately; this is not a claim that the controller is unsaturated or has unlimited recovery authority.

reported_windows.startup: Elapsed0-24h from local solar midnight. Same interval and specified initial states compared; no periodic-state assumption.
reported_windows.settled: Day08 after8 continuous days; periodicity checked, no daily reset.
reported_windows.acquisition: First true housing entry into -5 +/-0.5 C maintained continuously for at least10min. This thermal criterion alone does not authorize motor operation.
reported_windows.hardware_limit: Delivered power>=99% of300 W. Command-limited time uses>=99.9% of each chosen command ceiling.

references.supports: Limited PI and anti-windup method only; not hardware gains/delay values
Transport delay; our explicit startup branch replaces default initial input history with zero command

open_validation: Measure actual mounted sensor and heater step responses; select motor/ESC/battery temperature limits; test cold-start permissives, heater faults, sensor bias/noise and supply constraints. Fixed loss maps may be inaccurate at cold temperatures.

combined_stress_gain_candidates.purpose: Night damping candidate; warm-transition tracking still exceeds0.5K
Balanced tested stress candidate; settled heater-on error0.428K

metadata_note: See docs/Initial-Power-Clarification.txt. Original archived run-record prose for cold_ideal incorrectly said delivered power started at zero; native CSV and exact overrides always show immediate300W. Numerical results and parameters are unchanged.
